Field notes

A calm page

Good body text disappears. The reader follows the argument, not the letters, because the line is short enough to return to without searching, the leading leaves room between lines, and the contrast is strong without glare. Every size here comes from one scale, so the hierarchy reads at a glance. Links keep the same family and only change colour.

Second thoughts

A second paragraph keeps the same rhythm. Headings are set tighter than the text they introduce, labels in capitals get a little extra letter-spacing, and nothing on the page is smaller than a comfortable caption.
